name: Silk
source:
This beautiful, blonde magical girl from another dimension suddenly showed up in the Sakuragi's family living room. It seems that she has been cursed to wander throughout all existence for all of eternity, but she remains hopeful that one day she will be able to return to her homeworld. She hopes that [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url] will be able to help her in her goal. Her spirit certainly isn't crushed. She's very demanding and forceful, even haughty at times.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url] and [url=https://www.jastusa.com/target-pheromone.html]JAST USA[/url]]
